name: Kang Hyoung-chul
bio: Kang Hyoung-chul is a South Korean film director and screenwriter.

credits.title: Kiss for Tomorrow
credits.overview: A mysterious couple who cannot greet tomorrow without a kiss once a day experiences an unexpected parting during a cruise trip and embarks on a quest for the most desperate kiss of their lives.

credits.title: Hi-Five
credits.overview: After receiving organs from a mysterious donor, five ordinary people gain incredible powers and team up as "HI-FIVE" to stop a power-hungry cult leader from absorbing their abilities for godlike domination.

credits.title: Swing Kids
credits.overview: Rebellious Ki-soo from North Korea is mesmerized by tap dance in prison camps. Ki-soo joins as a team member of a dance team named 'Swing Kids'. Yet suddenly, their dreams about dancing in prison camps are put in danger.

credits.title: Tazza: The Hidden Card
credits.overview: Dae-gil has been skilled with his hands and has shown a strong desire for winning ever since he was a child. He will succeed his uncle and jump into the world of Tazza, risking his life in competition.

credits.title: Cheer Up Mr. Lee
credits.overview: A TV station follows a daily life of a young ‘wanna-be filmmaker’.

credits.title: Sunny
credits.overview: Seven girls become good friends in high school, then events pull them apart for 25 years. When one of the friends lies dying in a hospital, she wishes to see each of them one last time.

credits.title: Scandal Makers
credits.overview: Former teen idol Nam Hyeon-soo is now in his thirties and working as a radio DJ. One day a young woman named Jeong-nam shows up and claims to be his own daughter.
